source: segmentation (Blender simulation, background replaced by plain white)

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the island region vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.12 px in all frames (columns bg_shift_x/y in tracks/boat.csv)
camera.perspective_cues: none usable: background is uniform white (segmented); no ground plane, horizon or vanishing lines. Only cues: boat is drawn in front of the island's right tip (boat nearer the camera there) and the boat's apparent size grows ~4% over the clip (approaching the camera slightly).

objects.name: boat
objects.description: red-hulled fishing boat with white wheelhouse, white railings, tall mast; hull lettering 'AH805'. The only moving object.
objects.motion: translates leftward (-x) across the image at a nearly constant ~4.6-4.9 px/frame (template shift 232.1 px at f0 -> -105.4 px at f72); vertical image drift < 5 px; no rotation visible (hull axis ~4-8 deg throughout, the boat is seen broadside, bow pointing left)

apparent_size_px.template_scale_vs_f50: 0.98 at f0 -> 1.00 at ~f30 -> 1.02 at f72 (see boat_template.csv, +/-0.01 noise)

objects.reference_point_note: Blender origin of the boat is not visible; best proxies: hull bbox centre (hull_bbox_cx, ~y 633-640) or full bbox centre (bbox_cx, bbox_cy). For frames 0-34 use est_bbox_cx / est_hull_cx from boat_template.csv (mask bbox is truncated by the image edge).

objects.name: island
objects.description: pale sand/rock island (low elongated mound, beige/white with darker brown cliff at its right tip), left half of the image
objects.occlusion: right tip (x ~484-557) is covered by the boat's bow from frame 63 on

events.event: boat already moving at first frame (no start of motion in clip)
boat stern leaves right image edge -> boat fully in view
boat bow reaches/overlaps island right tip in image (boat in front; image overlap, not necessarily 3D contact)
boat still moving at last frame (no stop)

files.tracks/boat.csv: per-frame mask measurements of the boat
files.island_mask_f0.npy: packed bits of the island mask (960x960)
